description: This source file implements a PDF logo replacement pipeline. It includes functions for rasterizing PDFs, detecting logos within PDF pages through template matching, overlaying logos on detected regions, generating preview images, and managing job lifecycle and concurrency. The main class, PdfLogoReplaceManager, orchestrates job creation, status retrieval, and results, enabling asynchronous processing of logo replacement tasks within PDF documents.
